guide.setup: Stand tall with the bar at the upper chest, forearms vertical, glutes squeezed, and hands just outside the shoulders.
guide.execution: Brace, press the bar overhead, and move the head through once it clears the forehead. Lower under control.
guide.cues: Squeeze the glutes. Keep the bar close. Finish with biceps beside the ears.
guide.mistakes: Leaning back; flaring the ribs; pressing around the body; using leg drive on strict reps.
